findings.title: Mode C begin emit's decisions_captured: 0 contradicts the un-delta'd crystallization-warning requirement and Mode C's own back-filled decisions
findings.recommendation: The begin-emit scenario mandates decisions_captured: 0 for BOTH 'Mode B new, or Mode C crystallization'. But Mode C fires only after 2+ substantive decisions exist, and the delta's own Mode C accept scenario back-fills the Decisions section at the same moment the begin emit fires — so the emit records 0 while >=2 decisions are on disk. Worse, the LIVE un-delta'd requirement in the same capability ('Confirmed crystallization writes first emit', orbit/specs/orbit-run-summary-emit/spec.md:175-177) mandates the first explore-<TS>.json at crystallization 'capturing decisions to date' — a direct SHALL-level conflict over the same emit. The orientation surface would then render a just-crystallized sprint from a knowingly-false record. Reconcile with a delta: (A) scope decisions_captured: 0 to Mode B only and specify Mode C's begin emit carries the back-filled count (+ a MODIFIED block clarifying the crystallization requirement's 'first emit' IS this begin emit), or (B) keep the begin emit a pure scaffold record for both modes and add a MODIFIED block re-wording the crystallization first-emit scenario.

recommendation_options.label: A
recommendation_options.body: Scope decisions_captured: 0 + the continue-capturing recommendation to Mode B only; specify that Mode C's begin emit carries the back-filled decision count (and a maturity-consistent recommendation); add a MODIFIED block for the crystallization-warning requirement clarifying its 'first emit' IS this begin emit

recommendation_options.label: B
recommendation_options.body: Keep the begin emit a pure scaffold record for both modes; add a MODIFIED block re-wording the crystallization-warning requirement's first-emit scenario ('capturing decisions to date' becomes: the begin emit records the scaffold + citation decision; decisions land in explore.md and the next boundary emit)

findings.title: Begin-emit recommendation string diverges from the un-delta'd maturity requirement's Early canonical text
findings.recommendation: The un-delta'd 'Named-mode explore recommendation by maturity' requirement (orbit/specs/orbit-run-summary-emit/spec.md:183) quotes the Early (0-1 decisions) canonical string as '/orbit:explore <name> — continue capturing thinking' and its scenario greps for 'continue capturing thinking'. The begin emit is spec'd as '/orbit:explore foo — continue capturing' — repeated in design.md and hard-coded as the emit-less fallback in the orientation spec. Two SHALL-level texts specify different verbatim strings for the same field of the same emit. Align all three new-artifact spots to the Early canonical string verbatim (the smaller fix), or extend the delta to name a distinct begin-emit string in the maturity requirement.

findings.title: Degradation-ladder rungs 'zero live workstreams' and 'zero workstreams at all' are the same predicate as written, mandating two different renders
findings.recommendation: Live workstreams are defined as exactly active changes + staging explores, so 'zero live workstreams → bare renders the --full view' and 'zero workstreams at all → the existing no-active-changes message' trigger on the identical condition; the disambiguator lives only in a scenario qualifier. State the final rung explicitly in the requirement text — 'zero live workstreams AND zero parseable architecture docs → the existing no-active-changes message' — and mirror in design.md D3.

findings.title: orbit-engine-gates' un-scoped orbit status references become ambiguous once the bare path is repurposed, with no scoping delta
findings.recommendation: The gate-aware-status requirement reads 'orbit status SHALL render gate rows ... alongside artifact rows, and a one-line POSITION READOUT', and a consent scenario says 'orbit status --json carries the marker'. Pre-D3 these unambiguously denoted the --change form (bare errored); post-D3 the literal text mandates gate rows on bare invocations that render the sprint view instead. Add a small MODIFIED block to orbit-engine-gates scoping both references to 'orbit status --change <name>' (the imperative-label prohibition correctly stays surface-wide).

findings.title: Strip glyph legend does not cover stale/unpassed/superseded gate states
findings.recommendation: The closed glyph set covers passed/current/review-iterations/pending, while engine gate states include stale, unpassed, and superseded-(past). Add one sentence mapping the remaining states (e.g. superseded renders as passed-equivalent by design; stale/unpassed render unmarked with the WAITING band carrying the reason) so the renderer needs no judgment call.

findings.title: Eligibility label quoted lowercase ('ready when you are:') vs the engine's canonical 'Ready when you are:'
findings.recommendation: orbit-engine-gates line 301 defines the canonical capitalized label and existing tests grep for it. Capitalize the quote in the next-sourcing requirement so task 2.4's framing grep asserts the same literal.
